ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: a guest to be taken in

texts.li: [dislike] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} is about to join the colony, and {A_nameDef} has asked the council to think again. {A_nameDef} can't stand {X_objective}, and doesn't want to share a roof with {X_objective} for years to come.

[dislike] Before the colony takes {X_nameDef} in, {A_nameDef} wants a word. The two of them have been at each other since {X_nameDef} arrived, and {A_nameDef} says it will only get worse once {X_pronoun} lives here.

[faith] {A_nameDef} holds fast to the colony's faith, and {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} doesn't share it. Before {X_nameDef} is taken in, {A_nameDef} has asked the council to hear what that means to {A_objective}.
[unwilling] {X_nameDef} doesn't want to stay, and the colony means to keep {X_objective} all the same. {A_nameDef} has stood up in front of the council and said it would be wrong.
[crowded] There's no bed free as it is. {A_nameDef}, who has no room of {A_possessive} own, wants to know where {X_nameDef} would sleep before {X_pronoun} joins.
[food] The stores won't feed the colony four more days as it is. {A_nameDef}, who does the cooking, has asked the council whether another mouth is wise right now.

li.label: Take {X_nameDef} in all the same
li.outcome: The council heard {A_nameDef} out and took {X_nameDef} in all the same. {A_nameDef} said nothing more about it, and won't forget it.

li.label: {X_nameDef} stays a guest for now
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} stays a guest for now, and can be asked again another day. {A_nameDef} thanked the council for listening.

ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: family come to take them home

texts.li: {X_nameDef} has walked in from {FACTION}: {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION}, come to take {A_objective} home. {X_nameDef} is making for the gate, to wait there for the council's answer.
[partner] {X_nameDef} has come all the way from {FACTION} for {A_nameDef}, and will wait at the gate for an answer. {A_nameDef} went very quiet when {X_pronoun} was seen on the road.
[parent] {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION} {X_nameDef} has walked in from {FACTION} to ask for {A_nameDef} to come home, and will wait at the gate for the council's answer.
[forced] The colony kept {A_nameDef} from {FACTION} against {A_possessive} will. Now {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, has walked in to ask for {A_objective} back, and will wait at the gate.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} go home with {X_nameDef}
li.outcome: The colony saw {A_nameDef} to the gate, where {X_nameDef} was waiting, and the two of them set off together for {FACTION}.

li.label: {A_nameDef} stays, and {X_nameDef} goes home with {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: {COUNT} silver went out to {X_nameDef} at the gate, with the colony's word that {A_nameDef} is well and staying. {X_nameDef} took it and went home without {A_objective}.

li.label: {A_nameDef} stays
li.outcome: The council told {X_nameDef} that {A_nameDef} stays. {X_nameDef} went home alone, and {FACTION} think less of the colony for it.
